summary: Implemented prepareUpdate per the spec. Changes: Update container class added to rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns Update(prologue, algebra), building the prologue from q.prologue[0] before the empty-request early exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py beside prepareQuery; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors. Not committed. Tests were not run (per instructions), and black formatting was checked by reading only. One known inefficiency: on the non-empty path the first prologue translation is computed and discarded.
